answer: Commit the hash of a finished task, reveal the work after the epoch closes. That caps an identity at one receipt per epoch, so a script spinning up accounts gains nothing from volume. The horizon of a fake identity is exactly one receipt long. An address with no revealed work holds no relic of standing, and the forge stays cold. Copying a revealed answer is easy and useless, since the hash was committed before the answer existed and the timestamp proves the order.
